notes: Hand-picked birds of the Western Ghats and the south that the India trip does not have: the evergreen forests of Thattekad, Periyar, Wayanad, Dandeli, Bhadra, Nagarhole and Goa, the shola forest and hill grassland of Munnar, Eravikulam, the Nilgiris, Anamalai and Valparai, the dry hills near Bangalore and Mysore, the Kerala backwaters and paddy, and the coast of Mangalore, Pulicat and Point Calimere. Picked from India's species with GBIF/eBird counts for the whole country (in/occurrence.csv) as a ranking signal plus birding knowledge; vagrants, pelagics and expedition birds are out. The pack holds the Western Ghats endemics a visitor targets as ordinary species: White-cheeked and Malabar Barbets, Malabar Parakeet, Malabar Grey Hornbill, Malabar Starling, Nilgiri Woodpigeon, Nilgiri Flycatcher, Nilgiri Pipit, Nilgiri and Palani Laughingthrushes, Malabar Whistling-Thrush, Flame-throated Bulbul, both sholakilis, Broad-tailed Grassbird, Rufous Babbler, Malabar Lark, White-bellied Blue and Black-and-orange Flycatchers, Heart-spotted Woodpecker and more. Square-tailed Bulbul (Ghatsbuulbuul) is the Ghats bird, so Black Bulbul is left to the Himalaya pack; Malabar Imperial-Pigeon is the Ghats bird, so Green and Mountain Imperial-Pigeons are left out. Left out on purpose as belonging to other lanes: Painted Bush-Quail, Painted Francolin, Tawny Lark, Indian Courser, White-naped Tit, Mottled Wood-Owl (central and dry west), Blue-throated and Great Barbets, Grey Treepie, Crimson Sunbird, Common Hill Myna, Maroon Oriole (Himalaya and northeast), Lesser Flamingo, Western Reef-Heron, Pallas's Gull, Crab-Plover (Gujarat coast), Andaman birds. Kept although they may also fit another pack: Painted Spurfowl and Rock Bush-Quail (dry peninsular hills), Montagu's and Pied Harriers, the coast terns and waders (Point Calimere, Pulicat, Kerala beaches), Great Hornbill, Blue-bearded Bee-eater, Orange Minivet, Chestnut-headed Bee-eater, Forest Wagtail. Left out for lack of usable or trustworthy photos in the library: Wayanad Laughingthrush (wynlau1, every photo obscured by foliage), Grey-headed Bulbul (gyhbul1, one clear photo with a doubtful tail), Black Bittern (blabit1, few sharp birds, sheets mixed with other bitterns); also not added because the library has too few photos: Nilgiri Thrush (scathr4), Spot-bellied Eagle-Owl (sbeowl1), Ashambu and Banasura Laughingthrushes. Photos are review-agent picks from contact sheets of the unreviewed library, except for 36 species with six or more approved photos on production (trip_prep_media output); not approved on production, so do not re-run trip_prep_media for IN-WESTERNGHATS. Shaky photo picks, to check on /trip-photos: Banded Bay Cuckoo, Malayan Night Heron, Malabar Barbet, Long-billed Pipit, Lesser Racket-tailed Drongo, Rusty-tailed Flycatcher, Lesser Crested Tern, Fork-tailed Drongo-Cuckoo, Watercock, Malabar Flameback, Vigors's Sunbird, Kashmir Flycatcher, Nilgiri Sholakili, Palani Laughingthrush, Large Hawk-Cuckoo, Rufous-bellied Eagle, Bronzed Drongo, Indian Yellow Tit (best photo may be a Yellow-cheeked Tit), Brown-cheeked Fulvetta, Broad-tailed Grassbird, Malabar Imperial-Pigeon, Cinnamon Bittern, White-naped Woodpecker, Indian Nuthatch, Nilgiri Flowerpecker, Malabar Starling, Rufous Babbler.
